title: Meeting notes, assembled
sub: Ask for decisions in a fixed shape, then check every quote against the transcript before a person reads it.

nodes.l: Check each quote against the transcript
Person who was in the room reads it

steps.d:
Weekly sync, Thornwood product team: 25 lines, 4 attendees,
a shipped decision, a deferred discount, a role-owned action
item, and one open question about a vendor's pricing tier

steps.h: Your code asks the model for JSON matching the schema
steps.d:
attendees, decisions[{decision, owner, due_date, quote}],
open_questions

steps.h: Your code validates the reply against the schema
steps.d:
every required field present and the right type: valid,
no retry needed this run

steps.h: Your code checks each decision's quote against the transcript
steps.d:
2 kept: the signup flow ship, the FAQ ownership
1 dropped: "Cut the marketing budget by half."
(no matching sentence anywhere in the transcript)

steps.h: A person who was in the meeting reads the notes
steps.d:
sees: 2 decisions with their quotes, 1 dropped decision,
1 open question
confirms the two decisions are right before anyone acts
